purpose: Define one canonical field set for every legitimate external public profile so search engines and AI systems receive consistent identity signals without inventing business facts.

canonical_short_description.zh: Thai-China Logistics（泰中双向物流）提供泰国到中国、中国到泰国的跨境物流服务，可根据实际货物与地址咨询空运、陆运、海运、门到门、泰国上门取件、代收集货、行李与搬家等需求。
canonical_short_description.en: Thai-China Logistics provides cross-border logistics between Thailand and China, including Thailand-to-China and China-to-Thailand shipping. Air, land, sea, door-to-door, pickup and consolidation options are confirmed according to the actual cargo and route.

required_profile_fields: verified phone when the platform supports it
clear Thailand-China and China-Thailand service description
same service wording as operational facts registry

strong_identity_bridge.rule: An external source is attributable to this entity only when it contains enough strong identifiers to distinguish it from generic Thai-China logistics terminology or similarly named companies.

current_public_search_check.interpretation: Do not upgrade G4 or claim external entity verification from this search sample.

next_actions: Use this exact field standard when directly auditing or editing official Facebook/profile fields.
Audit legitimate external profile opportunities one by one; reject sources that cannot establish an identity bridge.
After a real external profile becomes publicly observable, rerun brand+identifier discovery checks.
Only then update external evidence registry and G3/G4 stage gates.
